title: Erlang CSV order import
context: Imports order lines from CSV. The file has a header row (name,qty,price) and ends with a newline. Prices may be whole numbers ("10") or decimals ("9.95"). Totals are money and must be exact, in integer cents.
code: lists:foldl(fun({_Name, Qty, Price}, Acc) -> Acc + Qty * Price end, 0, Rows).

expected.why: binary:split without [global] splits only at the first comma, so the 3-field match always fails
binary_to_float crashes on whole-number prices such as "10"
the header row and the empty line after the final newline are parsed too, so import crashes
money is summed as floats, so totals are not exact; use integer cents
